jobs.title: Director, Finance Data Strategy & Stewardship
jobs.description:
Description

The Experience:

As a member of the Controllership organisation, the Director of Finance Data Strategy & Stewardship will lead the end-to-end strategy, governance, and lifecycle management of Finance data across the enterprise. This role oversees the intake of new data into the Finance data lake, defines data models and governance standards, and ensures the reliability, quality, and compliance of Finance data used for reporting and analytics. The Director will also manage and develop a dedicated Data Governance and Reporting Controls team located in India, responsible for data stewardship, SOX-related data certification, and support for Finance reporting.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

Data Strategy & Intake Management
Define and drive the Finance data strategy, aligned with business priorities and downstream reporting needs.
Oversee the onboarding of new data sources into the Finance data lake, ensuring scalability, traceability, and alignment with enterprise architecture.
Partner with Finance, IT, and product teams to assess new data requirements and convert them into actionable data delivery roadmaps.
Data Modeling & Architecture
Lead the design of enterprise-grade Finance data models and semantic layers to support analytics, regulatory reporting, and operational Finance needs.
Ensure metadata standards, master data alignment, and consistent data definitions across systems.
Collaborate with data architects and engineering teams to ensure robust and efficient data pipelines.
Data Governance & Controls
Establish and enforce data governance standards, policies, and stewardship processes for Finance data.
Oversee the definition and monitoring of data quality rules, issue management, and remediation workflows.
Ensure compliance with SOX controls and certification requirements related to financial data and reporting.
Leadership of the India Data Governance Team
Lead and develop a team in India responsible for data governance, data quality operations, and stewardship activities.
Oversee processes related to Finance reporting controls, SOX testing support, and data certification.
Foster a culture of accountability, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.
Cross-Functional & Executive Partnership
Work closely with Finance, Accounting, FP&A, IT, Audit, and Data Engineering leaders to align on priorities and data needs.
Serve as a strategic advisor to senior executives on Finance data risks, data quality, and opportunities to improve reporting and insights.
Drive alignment between business requirements and technical implementation across the data value chain.
Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement
Establish KPIs, dashboards, and operating mechanisms to measure data quality, controls effectiveness, and team performance.
Identify and implement process improvements, automation opportunities, and best practices in data governance and data delivery.
Stay current with emerging technologies and regulatory trends shaping Finance data management.

You're Our Person If...

12–15+ years of experience in data management, data governance, Finance data strategy, or related fields.
Strong understanding of Finance processes, accounting flows, and financial reporting requirements; experience in audit or accounting is a plus.
Proven experience designing data models, managing data lakes, and overseeing data ingestion and transformation.
Leadership experience managing global or offshore teams, ideally in shared-services or GCC environments.
Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence executives and cross-functional partners.

jobs.title: Director, Enterprise Sales, Public Sector
jobs.description:
SLSQ427R938

While candidates in the listed location(s) are encouraged for this role, candidates in other locations will be considered.

Do you want to help solve the world's toughest business problems with Data and AI? This is what we do every day at Databricks.

We are looking for an Enterprise Sales Director to lead our growing Public Sector business in Ottawa. Leading a team of Enterprise Named and Strategic Account Executives, you will be measured by achieving your team's overall quota and growing Databricks' consumption. This is a team of account executives that are passionate about building a data ecosystem, technically knowledgeable, and have a strong desire to drive value for our customers.

You will oversee the sales team, implementing sales plans, expanding existing business and delivering accurate sales forecasting and reporting.

This is a fantastic opportunity to build upon a highly successful team achieving significant year on year growth, in a fast growing business which is a hugely impactful part of the Canadian sales organization. We are looking for owners, who will go the extra mile and want to be the very best at what they do.

The Impact You Will Have

Lead a team of account executives, ensuring you coach them to develop the skills and behaviors they will need to succeed
Establish company territory plans, team structure, individual quotas and patches for your team, including investment capacity requirements
Report on revenue forecast and strategic GTM programs
Partner with cross-functional teams to manage a complete revenue and customer success process
Inspire a culture of teamwork, leading with value and achieving desired customers outcomes
Develop trust-based relationships with customers and partners to ensure long-term success
Encourage learning and ongoing understanding of technical product details and our future product roadmap
Establish a revenue growth and investment plan in the first 90 days
Deliver our strategic growth plans, in collaboration with the other function leaders across Canada, ensure forecast accuracy and a predictable, high-growth business

What We Look For

Experience as a high-growth enterprise software sales leader with experience leading sales teams serving Named and Strategic customers within the Data, AI, Cloud, or SaaS Sales Industry, specifically within the Public Sector space.
History of exceeding sales quotas in similar high-growth technology companies
Ability to engage with and hire sales talent in the market
Focus and emphasis on methodology-based sales coaching, MEDDPIC and a Challenger mentality
Experience of value-based sales with both the business and IT stakeholders including C suite
Experience in leadership roles focused on managing sales organisations to influence, develop, and achieve objectives within Data, AI, Cloud, or SaaS sales
Extended Executive relationship network with key customers.
Knowledge of the partner ecosystem to help grow Enterprise strategic territories
Success implementing strategies for consumption and commitment-based sales revenue models.

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.

Benefits

At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Title:
Director, Finance (CSM)

Id:
21596

Type:
FullTime

Location:
Bolton, ON

At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible.

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy.

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

The Finance Director serves as a strategic business partner to the Leadership Team in support of Husky’s Global Service Business and Customer Success Management strategy. This role provides leadership for financial planning, forecasting, performance analysis, governance, and decision support to drive profitable growth, improve operational performance, and strengthen financial visibility across service revenue streams, including field service, contracts, parts, and other aftermarket offerings. The Finance Director is expected to influence strategic decisions, lead transformation initiatives, and build a high-performing finance capability that enables the business to scale effectively.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Forecasting

Lead the annual budget, quarterly forecast, and long-range planning processes for the service business.
Develop robust revenue, margin, cost, and headcount forecasts based on operational and commercial drivers.
Translate business strategies into financial plans with clear assumptions, risks, and opportunities.
Support scenario planning and sensitivity analysis for service growth, pricing, labor utilization, and investment decisions.

Performance Management & Analysis

Deliver timely and accurate monthly financial reporting and variance analysis for service revenue, gross margin, SG&A, and operating income.
Analyze business performance by region, product line, customer segment, channel, and service offering.
Monitor and explain key drivers of performance, including labor utilization, absorption, contract profitability, attach rates, response times, and service productivity.
Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve growth, profitability, and working capital performance.

Business Partnering

Serve as the senior finance partner to service leadership, operations, commercial teams, and Customer Success leaders, providing insight and challenge on strategic priorities, business performance, and investment decisions.
Lead financial evaluation of pricing strategies, contract renewals, service program design, and capital or operating investments to support sustainable growth and margin expansion.
Provide proactive challenge and decision support to business leaders by identifying risks, opportunities, and trade-offs across growth, productivity, service delivery, and resource allocation.
Lead cross-functional evaluation of new service offerings, business models, and transformation initiatives that improve service coverage, utilization, fulfillment, cost efficiency, and customer value.
Sponsor finance and business transformation initiatives across Finance and Customer Success Management, including enhancements to processes, reporting, operating metrics, and decision frameworks that support growth, profitability, and scalability.

Management Reporting & KPI Development

Develop and enhance dashboards, reporting tools, and KPIs that improve transparency and decision-making.
Standardize definitions and reporting for critical service metrics across the organization.
Improve reporting automation and self-service analytics capabilities where possible.
Present clear financial results and business insights to senior leadership

Process Improvement & Governance

Strengthen forecasting accuracy, reporting discipline, and financial controls within the service business.
Drive continuous improvement in FP&A processes, planning models, and reporting frameworks.
Ensure alignment with corporate finance requirements, accounting policies, and internal controls
Support month-end close and planning processes in partnership with accounting and finance teams.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field required.
CPA, CMA, CFA, or MBA preferred.
10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, finance business partnering, commercial finance, or operational finance, including leadership responsibility.
Experience in a service, aftermarket, field service, maintenance, or contract-based business strongly preferred.
Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and business analysis skills.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and experience with ERP and planning/reporting systems.
Executive presence with strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, and the ability to influence senior leaders across functions and regions.
Proven ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment

Preferred Experience In a Service Business

Understanding of service revenue models such as time and materials, service contracts, preventive maintenance, subscriptions, and parts/service bundles.
Experience analyzing operational KPIs such as technician utilization, service efficiency, contract margins, backlog, renewal rates, and service attach rates.
Familiarity with pricing strategy, labor productivity, installed base analytics, and customer lifecycle economics

Core Competencies

Strategic leadership
Financial and commercial acumen
Analytical rigor
Executive business partnership
Influence and executive communication
Problem solving
Process improvement
Results orientation and a bias for action

Team Development

Build and lead a high-performing finance team with strong capability in financial analysis, strategic thinking, business partnership, and change leadership.
Lead, coach, and develop team members, including succession planning, capability building, and development of future finance leaders.

Financial Leadership

Provide consistent, timely, accurate, and decision-oriented financial reporting for the service business, with greater automation and self-service access to insights where possible

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky Technologies TM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks.

Husky TechnologiesTM is committed to developing inclusive, barrier-free selection processes and work environments. If contacted in relation to a job opportunity or testing, you should advise the member of the Talent Acquisition team in a timely fashion of any disabilities that requires accommodation measures in order to enable you to be assessed in a fair and equitable manner.

Information received relating to accommodation measures will be addressed confidentially.

No agency or telephone inquiries please.

jobs.title: Head of Enterprise Infrastructure
jobs.description:
About the Company

At Future Secure AI, we're building something genuinely new — and we're looking for people bold enough to build it with us. We work at the frontier of AI, tackling big, real-world problems for global enterprises across multiple industries, armed with state-of-the-art technology and a culture that prizes courage, rigor, and relentless curiosity. Our BRAVER values aren't just words on a wall — they describe the kind of people we are and the standard we hold ourselves to every day. Our leadership team is entrepreneurial, experienced, and accessible, with an open-door policy that means you'll never be just a number here. We invest seriously in your growth because we know our success depends on yours. If you're ready to work alongside some of the brightest minds in the industry, push into uncharted territory, and do work that genuinely matters, Future Secure AI is the place for you.
About the Role

We are hiring a Head of Enterprise Infrastructure
to own the internal cloud environments that host Atlas, our proprietary platform for building and testing the AI Co-Workers we deliver to customers, along with the cloud services, enterprise repositories, LLM accounts, and tooling that support engineering and the wider organization. In this role, you’ll operate and manage these systems to the standard a global enterprise expects, setting internal service levels, evidencing compliance with our regulatory and customer obligations, managing cost with discipline, and building continuity through documented processes. You will report to the Chief Operating Officer and work closely with IT, Security, Platform, and Delivery to keep our infrastructure reliable, secure, and audit-ready.
Responsibilities

Own environment management: provisioning and maintaining internal platform environments, AICW namespace setup, and configuration parity, moving from ad hoc requests to a documented, repeatable self-service process.
Lead release and change management for internal cloud environments, including approvals, scheduling, post-change verification, and an auditable change record.
Own security and vulnerability remediation across internal environments to the standards and timeframes Security defines, tracking and reporting status to Security, assurance, and external auditors.
Manage access control for enterprise systems and repositories in line with the access model Security defines, including onboarding and offboarding, periodic access reviews, and least-privilege enforcement.
Act as major incident commander for internal environments, establishing on-call coverage and escalation paths, and running post-incident reviews that convert into permanent fixes.
Own cloud cost reporting, forecasting, and optimization, as well as vendor and tooling management, including contract negotiation and renewals in partnership with Finance and Legal.
Uphold enterprise-grade compliance standards, such as ISO 27001 and SOC 2, ensuring your work is independently verified by Security and fully evidenced.

Minimum Qualifications

Hands-on operational ownership of cluster and substrate infrastructure at enterprise scale, including upgrade, patch, capacity, and lifecycle management.
Proven release and change management within a controlled framework, producing an auditable record that stands up to external scrutiny.
Track record of vulnerability remediation to defined service levels, working alongside an independent security function.
Deep experience provisioning and configuring environments as code, including namespace and baseline configuration management.
Operational access management at scale across enterprise systems, source repositories, and platform environments, with least privilege and evidenced access reviews.
Demonstrated major incident command, including severity assessment, escalation, stakeholder communication, and post-incident improvement.
Cloud financial management: cost reporting, forecasting, and optimization with spend attributed to teams.
Commercial capability in cloud and vendor contract negotiation, renewals, and commitment management.
Experience operating inside a formal control framework such as ISO 27001 or SOC 2, and supporting external audit and customer assurance.
Demonstrated people leadership: hiring, developing, and retaining infrastructure engineers, and running sustainable on-call.
Sound judgment about what to automate, what to document, and what to decommission.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience standing up a platform or enterprise engineering function from an interim or unowned state.
Exposure to investor or IPO diligence, or to enterprise customer security assessments, on technology operations.
Multi-cloud operating experience across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
Background operating infrastructure supporting an AI or data-intensive product, including model account and API tenancy management.

Why Join Us?

A high-performance culture
State-of-the-art technology
Experience world-class leadership
Scale of impact and purpose
A competitive salary and a huge growth trajectory
Work with the best in the industry
Flexible work environment
Diversity and creativity

Disclaimer: 
We do not wish to be contacted by recruitment agencies. Our hiring process is managed in-house and the best way for candidates to express interest is by applying with your resume through our company website.

Our Privacy Policy outlines how we collect, use, share, and protect your personal data when you visit our website at   www.futuresecure.ai   (the "Website") and use our services.
